Fictional youth pitching log

Source: R/demo_pitch_log.R
demo_pitch_log.Rd

One month of pitching for a fictional 12U team: 15 appearances by four pitchers across nine dates, including a Saturday doubleheader. Built to show each outcome of check_pitch_counts(): clean weeks, a pitcher who returns before the required rest, and a day over the daily maximum. These are not real players or games.

Usage

demo_pitch_log

Format

A data frame with 15 rows and 5 columns:

pitcher

Fictional pitcher name.

age

Age on the game date, 10 to 12.

date

Game date (Date).

game

Opponent label; doubleheader games share a date.

pitches

Pitches thrown in that appearance.

Source

Created for this package by data-raw/demo-pitch-log.R.

Examples

check_pitch_counts(demo_pitch_log)
#>       pitcher       date age pitches appearances daily_max rest_days
